title: WWII: The Last Tiger
description:
In the game "The Last Tiger," you will control the fate of four tank commanders during World War II! You will participate in the most bloody tank battles of the Second World War. 
 Plan your maneuvers, coordinate your actions with allied forces, and outsmart your enemies in strategic tank warfare. Use cover, terrain, and flanking maneuvers to gain the upper hand on the battlefield.Game Features:• Campaigns for countries: US/UK, Germany, USSR, Japan
• Beautiful graphics and realistic battlefields
• Detailed tanks from World War II
• Atmospheric music and sounds

Wide selection of famous WWII tanks:United States • Sherman II
United Kingdom: • Cromwell
 • Sherman Firefly
Germany: • Tiger 1
 • Panzer-IV
 • Sdkfz251
 • Mörser Karl
USSR: • T-34/76
 • T-34/85
 • KV-I
 • KV-II
 • BT-7
 • T-35
Japan: • Type 89
Finland: 
 • BT-42
and many more.

"The Last Tiger" offers an unprecedented tank warfare experience, combining historical accuracy with intense action and strategic depth. Are you ready to rewrite the pages of history and become the best tank commander of World War II?
